desc: negative: Try to create a qlen underflow with QFQ/CBS
pre: ip link add dummy1 type dummy && ip link set dummy1 up
ip link set dev dummy1 up || true
ip addr add 10.10.10.10/24 dev dummy1 || true
tc qdisc add dev dummy1 root handle 1: qfq
tc class add dev dummy1 classid 1:1 parent 1: qfq
tc class add dev dummy1 classid 1:2 parent 1: qfq
tc qdisc add dev dummy1 handle 2: parent 1:1 cbs
tc qdisc add dev dummy1 handle 3: parent 2: netem delay 5000000000
tc filter add dev dummy1 parent 1: prio 1 u32 match ip dst 10.10.10.1 classid 1:1 action ok
tc filter add dev dummy1 parent 1: prio 2 u32 match ip dst 10.10.10.2 classid 1:2 action ok
tc qdisc replace dev dummy1 handle 4: parent 2: pfifo

readback.cmd: tc -s -j qdisc ls dev dummy1 parent 1:1
readback.name: verify
